subject: Civics
learningObjectives: Functioning of Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat
Three levels of Panchayats (Gram, Block, Zila)
misconceptions: Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat are the same (Sabha is the assembly of all adults)

practiceExercises.question: Who is the head of the Gram Panchayat?
practiceExercises.explanation: The Panchayat members (Panches) elect a Sarpanch as the head.

flashcards.back: Meeting of all adults who live in the area
District level of the Panchayat system

revisionNotes: Panchayati Raj is the first tier of democratic government.
commonMistakes: Confusing the Secretary (govt appointed) with Sarpanch (elected)
introduction: Welcome to the study of Panchayati Raj. In this chapter, we explore essential concepts and their applications in the world around us.
realLifeConnection: You can see the principles of Panchayati Raj in your daily activities, from the way you organize your day to the nature you see outside.
storyBasedExplanation: The Quest for Knowledge: A group of students discovers the hidden secrets of Panchayati Raj through a series of exciting adventures.

teacherExplanation: Focus on the core pillars of Panchayati Raj. Connect theoretical knowledge with practical observations and NCERT guidelines.
